text:
Alex: morning — quick preflight interlock for the rollout tomorrow. What I did: finished the pre-prod perf tests for the new routing policy (sustained qps 2.8k at p95 latency target). Blockers: still seeing a small KV cache miss spike when sequence lengths > 2k. Today: will triage and open a hotfix PR; tagging infra + ml for impact.

Maya: thanks — can you paste the test script/commands? want to validate resource requests on Dedicated.

Alex: sure — command I used:
```
./test_load --model=realtime-v2 --qps=2800 --seqdist=long-tail --duration=10m --trace=./out.trace
```
Also added cpu/memory autoscale hints in the k8s patch, will post the PR in a bit.

Jin: noted. those traces show the KV misses correlate with GC pauses on host nodes in the 03 AZ. ops-bot, any node drain events overnight?

ops-bot: [AUTO] NodeEvent: node/gke-redwood-03 was drained for maintenance at 2024-09-16T03:40:12Z (cordon/evict).

Priya: if it's tied to GC we should try bumping the worker runtime mem limit for that slice to avoid eviction. Also, what slice is the canary traffic on?

Alex: canary slice is slice-7 (2% traffic) routed to dedicated-pool-alpha. I can bump the memory for slice-7 by +1Gi as a temporary mitigation.

Sam: quick ops heads-up — raising memory will change packing on the pool; if you do it, please coordinate with me so I can check CUDA memory fragmentation.

Maya: timeline for the rollout: gating on the KV fix + smoke tests. If Alex can open the PR within 2 hrs we can still do a t-minus-6h validation window before the launch.

Alex: opening PR now: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/4821 — includes the mem bump and a small kv-cache guard (early-return on corrupted prefix). PTAL.

Jin: reviewing. small note: in the guard maybe just log once every 50 events to avoid log flood.

Alex: good call, will change that.

Priya: QA — can you run the smoke harness with the mem bump and confirm the token-level latencies are stable? Test tag: smoke/preflight/2387654321.

Sam: I'll reserve the GPUs on dedicated-pool-alpha for the window (t-minus-6h). Also will watch temperature and PCIe errors during the smoke.

Maya: product question — are feature flags ready? we need a kill-switch and a slow-start policy (2% -> 10% -> 30%).

Alex: flags in place: feature_flag:route_v2 = off by default, rollout_policy = slow_start_2_10_30. Config snippet:
```yaml
feature_flag:route_v2: true
rollout_policy: 
  - pct: 2
    duration: 1h
  - pct: 10
    duration: 2h
  - pct: 30
    duration: 4h
```
Will add the kill-switch toggle to the PR description.

Maya: nice. Also add the fallback model mapping (route_v1) in the config so we have automatic fallback on errors.

Alex: added fallback mapping to the PR.

Jin: code review done, left one comment about reducing log verbosity and one about a nil-check.

Alex: addressing comments now.

Priya: QA update — smoke harness queued, should finish in ~25m. Will post results here.

ops-bot: [AUTO] CI: platform/pr/4821 passed unit tests (12/12), integration queued.

Sam: FYI I'm scheduling a 30-min watch window starting at t-minus-2h (ops-monitor channel). I'll post the watch link.

Maya: perfect. final checklist for tomorrow:
- PR merged + green CI
- smoke harness pass on mem-bump
- infra reservation confirmed (Sam)
- flag and rollback tested (Priya)
- on-call handover noted (Jin)

Alex: got it — will ping again after PR merge. thanks team :thumbsup:

Priya: smoke passed — 95/100 tokens within target, no erros spike. tagging @Maya @Sam.

Maya: excellent. if nothing else pops up we'll stick to the t-minus plan. I'll post the final launch checklist in the morning.

Jin: on-call handover set for 08:00 UTC. I'll be available for the first 3 hours of the rollout.

Sam: reservation and watch link: https://ops.redwood/watch/2387654321. I'll post live metrics there.

Alex: PR merged at 2387654385. thanks all.

Maya: great work, let's keep the handoff clean.

(End of thread)
